title: PTA Notifies Mobile Virtual Network Operators (MVNO) Policy Framework After Cabinet Approval
body: The Pakistan Telecommunication Authority notified the Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) Policy Framework following approval by the Federal Cabinet. The framework allows MVNOs to offer nationwide mobile communication services without holding spectrum. MVNOs may enter into commercial agreements with one or more mobile network operators, and MNOs may partner with multiple MVNOs. MVNOs will not be eligible for any direct spectrum assignment. The framework replaces the previous MVNO guidelines introduced in 2006.

title: Policy Framework for Mobile Virtual Network Operator (approved, December 2025)
body: Policy Framework for Mobile Virtual Network Operator. MVNO licences shall be granted for a period of fifteen years. MVNOs shall provide mobile communication services across Pakistan excluding Azad Jammu and Kashmir and Gilgit-Baltistan. Licensees shall pay annual regulatory dues, Universal Service Fund and Research and Development contributions.

title: PTA Opens Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) Licensing in Pakistan
body: Interested entities are invited to apply for the grant of Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) Licenses in accordance with the approved Policy Framework and PTA licensing requirements. The initial licence fee for a nationwide MVNO licence has been set at USD 140,000 payable upfront. MVNO licences shall be issued for a period of fifteen years. MVNOs will offer mobile services under their own brands through commercial agreements with licensed mobile network operators.

title: PTA Will Now Register New Telcos With No Physical Networks in Pakistan
body: The Pakistan Telecommunication Authority released a consultation draft for the MVNO licence, with a deadline of 22 April 2026 for stakeholder feedback. The regime would allow operators to launch branded mobile services without owning towers or spectrum, purchasing network capacity from existing licensed mobile network operators.

title: Zuma Resources Teams Up with Telna North America, Launches UK Subsidiary
body: The board of Zuma Resources Limited approved a collaboration agreement with Telna North America, Inc. to launch global eSIM and physical SIM connectivity services and to support international roaming and telecom infrastructure solutions. The board also approved the establishment of a wholly owned subsidiary in the United Kingdom to manage international telecom partnerships and global connectivity services.

title: Zuma Resources Enters Deal With US Telecom Giant to Launch eSIM Business
body: Under the agreement Telna shall provide Zuma Resources Limited access to its multi-IMSI global connectivity infrastructure, enabling eSIM connectivity, mobile data services, voice and SMS services and international roaming across multiple networks. The company is planning to obtain a Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) license from the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority, subject to regulatory approvals and applicable legal requirements. The agreement has an initial term of three years subject to renewal.

title: PSX moves Zuma Resources to normal counter after compliance rectification
body: The Pakistan Stock Exchange moved Zuma Resources Limited back to the normal counter after the company rectified its compliance status. Zuma Resources Limited has announced telecom and eSIM connectivity plans through a collaboration agreement.

title: Effortel Enters Pakistan as MVNO Regulations Open One of Asia's Largest New Telecom Opportunities
body: Effortel announced its entry into Pakistan to support the launch of new MVNOs and digital mobile operators as Pakistan opens MVNO licensing. Effortel provides MVNO enablement platforms and telecom operational systems, delivering real-time charging and billing, customer management, digital onboarding, product catalog management and integration with host mobile networks. Effortel has enabled more than thirty MVNO launches across eight mobile networks worldwide.
